convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator (ColorXCCXCandle) requiring the custom .ex5 file, plus two external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) for trade execution and smoothing algorithms. Custom indicator buffers must be replicated in Python.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars before indicator is valid
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: Signal timestamp calculation for trade functions

other_exits: BuyPosClose triggered when ColorXCCXCandle buffer4[SignalBar]==0 (bearish color), SellPosClose triggered when buffer4[SignalBar]==2 (bullish color)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lot from MM param, FREEMARGIN/BALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE=MM as fraction of respective equity measure

custom_logic_notes: Entry uses ColorXCCXCandle buffer index 4 (color buffer). Long signal: Clr[1]==2 (current bar bullish) AND Clr[0]<2 (previous bar not bullish) — requires color transition to bullish. Short signal: Clr[1]==0 (current bar bearish) AND Clr[0]>0 (previous bar not bearish) — requires color transition to bearish. BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are separate booleans gated by input params. When SignalBar==0, the EA recalculates every tick (intrabar); otherwise only on new bar. Recount flag triggers recalculation on next tick if CopyBuffer fails. Signal timestamp is set to last bar date + timeframe seconds for trade identification. BuyPosOpen and SellPosOpen are mutually gated: long entry only if Clr[0]<2 (prior bar wasn't already bullish), short entry only if Clr[0]>0 (prior bar wasn't already bearish).
python_conversion_notes: The ColorXCCXCandle custom indicator must be fully reimplemented in Python. It uses two smoothing passes from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh: a dominant smoothing (default JJMA, period 15, phase 15) and a minor smoothing (default T3, period 15, phase 15). The JJMA (JMA) and T3 algorithms are non-trivial adaptive smoothers that need faithful porting. The color buffer (index 4) outputs 0=bearish, 1=neutral, 2=bullish. Trade execution functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_) come from TradeAlgorithms.mqh and handle margin calculation, order sending, and position management — these must be replaced with Python broker API calls. The position_gate logic is embedded in the trade functions, not explicitly checked before signal generation. SL/TP of 1000/2000 pips are likely intended as points (not pips), so for 5-digit brokers this equals 100/200 pips — verify with original author intent.
